_comment: Tier-2 for dune::heat#0 and dune::heat#1 — two forms (steady and transient) serve both, and dt is a dune.ufl.Constant so the dt sweep is free; wall time 99 s on 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Measured on an 8x8 P1 grid: DirichletBC(space, 100.0) gives left mean 100.0000 and right mean 100.0000 — one constant cannot serve two segments — while DirichletBC(space, conditional(x[0]<0.5, 100, 0)) gives 100.0000 and 0.0000. With the mass term the field mean marches 23.4719, 28.4493, 31.8874, 34.4721, 36.5051; with the stiffness term ALONE it reads 46.0567 at every one of five steps, which is exactly the steady-state solution — the transient is simply absent. The tell is dt: raising dt from 0.01 to 100 changed the transient's first step (46.0444, then straight to 46.0567), while the stiffness-only loop is dt-independent by construction. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 marches the "stiffness only" loop with the TRANSIENT scheme, i.e. with the mass term put back. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'stiffness_only_is_steady_at_every_step=True', 'stiffness_only_equals_the_steady_solution=True', 'dune_heat_transient_traps_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
